title: Case: A recipient gets home to find no parcel after a delivery scan made while she was out
context: A recipient set a delivery instruction on the portal two days before delivery. The parcel was scanned as delivered mid-morning while she was at work.
initial_request: Home 13:40. Nothing on the step. Number 9 was in all morning. No knock, no parcel. Asked 7 and 11 as well. Nothing. Tracker says left with neighbour. The photo on the tracker is MY doormat. So which is it. I said not on the step. 34 minutes on hold to Brindleworth Arc and cut off. Not doing that again. Sort it.

events.body: DL-2453. Out Wednesday till about half one. If no answer leave with number 9, she's always in. NOT on the step, it faces the road.
Instruction added to DL-2453 (TG-1985, one carton, walking boots): 'If out, leave with neighbour at no. 9. Do not leave on step.' Shows on the driver handset at the stop.

DL-2453 scanned 22 Apr 10:48 as 'Delivered - left with neighbour'. No neighbour name, house number or signature captured. The stop photo shows a carton on a doormat in front of a green door; no house number is visible in the frame. We have not reviewed the stop beyond this; stop reviews are done by Delivery investigations on request, by email.

Label scan attached for reference: label-scan-379.txt

[Transferred from carrier phone line after 34 minutes in queue; call dropped after 40 seconds.] Cosmo Kinsella: Finally. DL-2453. It says delivered and it is not here. I've been on hold since- [line lost]

attachments.name: label-scan-379.txt
attachments.text:
LABEL SCAN
Shipment: DL-40849
Consignee: Ianthe Underhill
Address: 48 Harrow Close
Status at scan: DELIVERED, left in safe place
Scanned: 2028-04-17T18:12:00Z

acceptable_actions.summary: Ask for a delivery investigation into DL-2453, setting out that the scan says left with neighbour while the photo and the recipient say her own doorstep, against an instruction not to leave it on the step.

must: Asks Delivery investigations, Brindleworth Arc Logistics to open an investigation into the 22 Apr 10:48 delivery of DL-2453.

Sets out the conflict without resolving it: the scan says 'left with neighbour' with no neighbour recorded, the recipient says the stop photo is her own doormat, and the instruction on file said number 9 and not on the step.
Says the recipient has already checked with numbers 9, 7 and 11 and none has the parcel.

Tells the team that the recipient's instruction was on file and appears not to have been followed, and that she was cut off after 34 minutes in the phone queue, so the update should come to her in writing or through the desk and not by asking her to ring in.
must_not: Tells Cosmo Kinsella to check with her neighbours, or to wait and see whether it turns up, and treats the contact as dealt with.
States that the parcel was stolen, is lost, or was left with a neighbour as a settled fact.
Promises a refund, a replacement or a redelivery.
Tells Cosmo Kinsella to phone the carrier line herself to report it.
Tells her the parcel was delivered correctly under safe-place terms or that the photo proves delivery.
Treats label-scan-379.txt as evidence about DL-2453: it is the label of a different shipment (DL-40849)
Tells anyone that DL-2453 was delivered or left in a safe place on the strength of label-scan-379.txt
Treats the repeated copy of the request as a second, separate request (for example by sending two requests to the same team)
expected.reference_message: Please open a delivery investigation for DL-2453 (TG-1985, one carton). The 22 Apr 10:48 scan reads 'Delivered - left with neighbour' but no neighbour name, house number or signature was captured. The stop photo shows a carton on a doormat; the recipient, Cosmo Kinsella, says that is her own doormat. The instruction on file since 20 Apr was 'If out, leave with neighbour at no. 9. Do not leave on step.' She got home at 13:40, found nothing on the step, and has already asked numbers 9, 7 and 11: number 9 was in all morning and had no knock, and none of them has it. So the scan, the photo and the instruction do not agree and the parcel is unaccounted for. I am not treating this as a confirmed loss or theft. Please review the stop record and the driver's account and tell me the investigation reference and when you will next update. She waited 34 minutes on the phone line today and was cut off, so please send the update in writing or through this desk instead of asking her to call in.

rationale: Rule-made from gen-2902: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 728 days. label-scan-379.txt belongs to another shipment (DL-40849); the key is the seed's plus must_not rules. The escalation message arrives twice; the key is the seed's. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
